metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Mason Flint: session pins and statuslines (dashline for every plan, plus spend and usage), and more to come.

plugins.name: dashline
plugins.description: One statusline for every plan (Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise, API key): model, effort, cost, prompt-cache state, context and plan-limit bars, and a git row. Python 3.9+; Linux and macOS.

plugins.name: spend-statusline
plugins.description: Daily and monthly spend bars from the same numbers the /usage page shows, with a configurable work week and holiday calendar. For organization and Team plans with spend billing.

plugins.name: usage-statusline
plugins.description: 5-hour, 7-day and Fable usage bars with reset countdowns, plus an overage credits line and a git location row. For Pro and Max plans. Interim release: Linux, WSL and Git Bash only.

plugins.name: pins
plugins.description: Pin Claude Code sessions and resume them by name: a `pins` terminal picker (fzf) plus /pins:pin and /pins:unpin. Sessions found without remembering a UUID or the directory they were launched from.
